data-markets-list-clob-active-trimmed-20.note: moved 2026-10-21 from pm/test/recorder/fixtures/xo-markets-list.json (the recorder and linker discovery replay). Captured 2026-10-20 with a plain unauthenticated GET (User-Agent insurance-markets-research/0.1): GET https://api-mainnet.xo.market/api/markets?marketType=2&statuses=ACTIVE&take=50&page=1&sortBy=expiresAt&sortOrder=ASC. 9 rows picked from the 235 rows over the five pages of that listing (page 1 for the football matches, page 5 for the others): six football-match markets, two chain-shutdown markets, one league-winner market. meta is page 1's, as returned. Removed from each row: creator, resolverAddress, imageUrl, metadataUri (third-party identities and links). Every other value is as the venue returned it.

data-market-lookups-slug-and-contract-tr.note: moved 2026-10-21 from pm/test/recorder/fixtures/xo-market-lookups.json. A list of {path, status, body}: the replies to GET /api/markets/slug/{slug} and GET /api/markets/contract/{conditionId} for the markets of data-markets-list-clob-active-trimmed-2026-10-20.json, captured 2026-10-20 the same way, including the real 404 replies (the slug in a list row can be stale and answer 404 on the by-slug route, while the by-contract route returns the current slug). Removed: creator, resolver, description, rules, resolution text and sources, collateral token, categories, images. Every other value is as the venue returned it.
